title: client.rs: check_auth_status is pub(crate) but called via fully-qualified path in blob.rs
description: blob.rs lines 141, 226: calls JmapClient::check_auth_status(status) using the fully-qualified path. Since this is an inherent method on JmapClient and upload_blob/download_blob are impl blocks on JmapClient, calling self.check_auth_status(status)... wait, the method is 'fn check_auth_status(status: StatusCode)' — it takes no self. It is a static (associated) method. The fully-qualified path is therefore correct and necessary. This is a non-finding; file a note instead.
